receivable_schema.sql: DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic.receivable_document AT (VERSION=>1322))

receivable_keys.sql:
SELECT source_system,source_table, count(*) AS rows,
        count(transaction_id) AS trans_id_nonnull, count(DISTINCT source_doc_entry) AS doc_entries,
        count(branch_id) AS branch_nonnull, count(DISTINCT branch_id) AS branch_values,
        min(document_date) AS first_date,max(document_date) AS last_date
        FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic.receivable_document AT (VERSION=>1322)) GROUP BY 1,2

receivable_branch_distribution.sql: SELECT branch_id,count(*) AS rows FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic.receivable_document AT (VERSION=>1322)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

invoice_number_12345.sql: SELECT source_system,doc_entry,doc_num,series,doc_date,canceled,currency,doc_total FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE doc_num=?

sales_2026_months.sql:
SELECT substr(doc_date,1,7) AS month,canceled,currency,count(*) AS documents,
        sum(try_cast(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) AS document_total FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408))
        WHERE doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

sales_identity_duplicates.sql: SELECT count(*) AS duplicate_keys FROM (SELECT source_system,source_table,doc_entry FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1)

line_identity_duplicates.sql: SELECT count(*) AS duplicate_keys FROM (SELECT source_system,source_table,doc_entry,line_num FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 HAVING count(*)>1)

invoice_to_receivable_key_coverage.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS sales_documents,
        count(r.source_doc_entry) AS matched_receivable_rows,
        count(r.transaction_id) AS transaction_ids_available,
        count(CASE WHEN trim(coalesce(r.transaction_id,'')) NOT IN ('','0','-1') THEN 1 END) AS non_sentinel_transaction_ids,
        count(CASE WHEN trim(coalesce(r.branch_id,'')) NOT IN ('','0','-1') THEN 1 END) AS non_sentinel_documentary_branch
        FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) s LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic.receivable_document AT (VERSION=>1322)) r ON s.source_system=r.source_system AND s.doc_entry=r.source_doc_entry AND r.source_table='OINV+INV6'

candidate_physical_classification_label.sql: SELECT "physical_classification_label", count(*) AS rows FROM read_parquet(?) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

candidate_physical_classification_status.sql: SELECT "physical_classification_status", count(*) AS rows FROM read_parquet(?) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

candidate_physical_state.sql: SELECT "physical_state", count(*) AS rows FROM read_parquet(?) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
